history.position: THIS COURSE TEACHES NO REPAIR HISTORY. The engine's lead decisions (the omission default 'average', mean-deviation dropped, s.14 ncLeadBasis required, the cost P-label basis, the 2010 Schedule only) landed before its merge and before any lesson was written; they are provenance. The digest describes the engine as it is.

regulatoryRule: Every Act, regulation and guidance taught is named with its edition or gazette date and the date read (2026-09-26), printed in digest section 2 and asserted against the vendored FINDINGS-tender.md. Licensed texts (AIPN model contracts, API standards) are never quoted. No legal threshold is invented: every one the engine applies is cited to its section; a figure that could not be sourced is a required input with no default.

scopeSeams.NPV and discounting: OWNED BY the economics courses. SC2 imports the canonical cashflow.ts npv for the life-cycle cost and says so.
scopeSeams.Monte Carlo and P labels for reserves: OWNED BY the uncertainty course. SC2 samples through lib/stats on a stated seed and teaches the COST reading of the exceedance labels only.
scopeSeams.well time and cost estimating: OWNED BY the drilling courses. SC2 imports wellCost for the programme days and the should-cost.
scopeSeams.the Petroleum Industry Act 2021 and fisc: OWNED BY the pia course (EC7). SC2 cites the 2010 content Act only.

namingCollisions.responsive: a bid still in the evaluation at that stage. Section 25.
namingCollisions.lowest evaluated cost: the engine's evaluated cost, never the quoted price. Sections 8, 11, 25.
namingCollisions.most advantageous: the highest combined score under stated settings. Sections 9, 25.
namingCollisions.content: Nigerian content in the Schedule's measured unit. Sections 14, 25.
namingCollisions.P90: for a cost, the LOW figure (exceedance). Sections 18, 25.
namingCollisions.should-cost: the company's independent estimate, never a bid. Sections 19, 25.

openItems.ENGINE FINDING 1 (wording): The completion-time reasons pluralise 'weeks' after 1: evaluatedCosts prints 'completion in 7 weeks is 1 weeks beyond the minimum 6' (well services WS3, quoted verbatim in digest section 8). Learners read engine messages as course content; repair first (engines PR), then re-cut. No number changes.
openItems.DECISION omission rule: Lead decision: the course teaches and grades the cited 'average' rule only; 'highest' is shown in Expert m05 in the engine's own words as the uncited option.
openItems.DECISION s.14 reading: Lead decision: both readings side by side as an open question of the Act; the Professional capstone grades the lead under BOTH readings, each field naming its reading.
openItems.DECISION cost P labels: Lead decision: kept per lib/conventions/percentile.js; Expert m02 teaches the reversal; the Expert capstone grades a reimbursable P90 cost (the LOW cost) and the discriminate sweep carries the 90th percentile as a wrong method.
openItems.DECISION shared vendored paths: cashflow.ts and afe.js stay at NextGen's blobs (see enginesVendoredAt). When the pin moves to 9187701 or later, cashflow.ts 3.11 and afe.js arrive with their own re-cuts, not with this course.

fieldsDiscrimination.onitsha_on3_technical_percent: weighted points quoted, unweighted mean of the scores, weights reversed, scores read out of four, the top bid s relative score
fieldsDiscrimination.onitsha_on2_corrected_price: quoted total governs, the deviation added, the evaluated cost quoted, the quoted amount governs every line
fieldsDiscrimination.onitsha_on3_omission_amount: highest rule, the failed bid prices it, the excluded bids price it, the lowest price, the median price
fieldsDiscrimination.onitsha_on1_evaluated_cost: discount not deducted, credit for early completion, the discount deducted twice, the rate on every week
fieldsDiscrimination.onitsha_on2_commercial_score: linear price method, the failed bid in cmin, the quoted totals scored, the ratio inverted, the combined score quoted
fieldsDiscrimination.onitsha_top_combined_score: weights swapped, absolute technical method, linear price method, highest omission rule, the lowest cost bid s score
fieldsDiscrimination.umuahia_um2_life_cycle_cost: residual not credited, discounted from year 0, undiscounted sum, residual taken off undiscounted, ten percent rate
fieldsDiscrimination.umuahia_um4_evaluated_cost: highest omission rule, no life cycle, no delivery adjustment, the omission left out, the failed bid prices the omission
fieldsDiscrimination.umuahia_alb_limit: sample standard deviation, the failed bid kept, two standard deviations, the mean quoted, the quoted totals used
fieldsDiscrimination.umuahia_um3_overall_content: pooled across units, unweighted mean of the items, weighted by quantity, the casing content alone, weighted by the whole bid price
fieldsDiscrimination.umuahia_s14_lead_points: read as relative, lead over the whole field, pooled contents, unweighted contents
fieldsDiscrimination.umuahia_s14_lead_relative: read as points, relative to the leader, lead over the whole field, ratio not less one
fieldsDiscrimination.okigwe_dayrate_mean_cost: next seed, the planned payment, the p50, no mobilisation fee, the contractor cost mean
fieldsDiscrimination.okigwe_reimbursable_p90_cost: the 90th percentile quoted, the p50, next seed, the fee left out, the mean
fieldsDiscrimination.okigwe_dayrate_company_pays: the contractor part, the whole expected overrun, next seed, the share quoted, the reimbursable company part
fieldsDiscrimination.okigwe_should_cost_estimate: contingency dropped, npt at zero, npt at the maximum, contingency on the per day items only, the lump sum price
fieldsDiscrimination.okigwe_operator_amount: the partners total, the larger partner s share, contingency dropped, the whole estimate
fieldsDiscrimination.okigwe_award_ratio: lowest cost award, inverted, against the base without contingency, the quoted total, against the lump sum
